title: Many Allay Butlers
description: Adds a few allay variants dressed like butlers!
body:
# Many Allay Butlers!

Allays wearing suits!

![Suit variant](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/161c03a163dcd37deb936c62f814a50ae215b1bb.png)

It adds 9 variants: 

- Suit with horns and bow
- Suit no horns
- Suit no bow
- Velvet
- Sunflower
- Oceanic
- Soldier
- Druid
- Halloween

# **IMPORTANT**

**For this pack to work you must have a mod that allows for loading CEM models!**
- [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) + [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) is tested and works.
- Optifine is not tested, but seeing as they made the format it should probably work.
- [Custom Entity Models](https://modrinth.com/mod/cem) is not tested and may not work.

[![ETF Icon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Traben-0/Entity_Texture_Features/master/.github/README-assets/icon.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) [![EMF Icon](https://github.com/Traben-0/Entity_Model_Features/blob/master/src/main/resources/icon.png?raw=true)](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)
